name: production-umbat-cap
description: Umbat (Muaat agent): 'produce up to 2 units that each have a cost of 4 or less in a system that contains one of their war suns or flagship'. Muaat exhausts Umbat on itself at 304 (war sun there) and tries 3 units (2 dreadnoughts + 1 cruiser): both paths refuse the 3rd unit (bot handler: ephemeral refusal; engine: validate), then 2 dreadnoughts are produced and paid. War suns / flagships are never offered (cost > 4). diffIgnore: the legacy path places the dreadnoughts one at a time, which sets the capacity/fleet marker stored.violatedSystems (Reset Build leaves it, as in the original); the engine refuses the whole payload, so it never sets it.
